warnings: The table is TWO level-bands x two marks, and every one of the four cells is recorded separately: band 'ระดับอะเส / ระดับพื้นชั้น 1' (C0 = '—', C1 = 0.20x0.20 4-Ø12mm Ø6mm@VARIES) and band 'ตอม่อ / ฐานราก' (C0 and C1 both 0.20x0.20 4-Ø12mm Ø6mm@0.10). C1 therefore has two rows, not one — merging them loses the fact that the pedestal is @0.10 while the storey column above it is @VARIES.

Pedestal (ตอม่อ) box size and main bars are identical to the normal (non-seismic) column table on S-05 (0.20x0.20m, 4-Ø12mm), but the pedestal stirrup is tightened from Ø6mm@0.15 there to Ø6mm@0.10 here. The other seismic override is C1's storey-column stirrup, printed '@VARIES' instead of a fixed spacing — resolved by this same sheet's column-rebar-spacing drawing (below the table): Ø6mm@0.10m over a 0.60m zone at each end and Ø6mm@0.15m over the 1.80m middle, totalling the 3.00m between ระดับพื้นชั้น 1 and ระดับอะเส.
This sheet's own note recommends using this S-10 detail for seismic zones 1 and 2 (province lists transcribed in the companion notes file, _view2_notes_seismic12.json).
